# Keyboard Shortcuts and Vim Mastery

Cairn is engineered from line one with a keyboard-first philosophy.

## Global Application Hotkeys

- `Mod+O` — Open vault folder selection dialog
- `Mod+S` — Save active note immediately
- `Mod+B` — Toggle left sidebar (File tree / Search)
- `Mod+Shift+B` — Toggle right sidebar (Backlinks panel)
- `Mod+Shift+F` — Focus vault search panel in Activity Rail
- `Mod+Shift+V` — Toggle Vim modal editing mode

## Vim Normal Mode Keybindings

- `j`, `k`, `h`, `l` — Cursor movement
- `w`, `b`, `e` — Word jumping
- `ciw`, `diw` — Change / delete inside word
- `yy`, `p` — Yank and paste line
- `u`, `Ctrl+r` — Undo and redo
- `:w` — Save active note
- `:q` — Close tab
